notes: The programme page is a Parcoursup form: it is a French national platform. For a Moroccan Baccalauréat holder the dossier does not go through Parcoursup (per the Campus France Maroc pages), so applicationChannel was intentionally not extracted. The quoted fee of 178 EUR/year corresponds to the French/EU rate ("Par année 178 euros"); the differentiated non-EU rate of 2902 EUR for Licence stated on the Campus France page is a general figure for French public higher education, not stated for this programme, so it was left out of tuition. The page does not give a duration in ECTS or semesters, nor any tuition period other than 'year'.
